SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("po_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'po_number' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "po_number" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'po_number' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "po_number" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_value' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "total_value" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'total_value' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "total_value" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'expected_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "expected_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'expected_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "expected_date" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'ordered_at' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "ordered_at" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'ordered_at' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "ordered_at" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:purchase_orders}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("po_number"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("notes"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "status" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:purchase_orders}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:purchase_orders}} ("po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, $5::numeric, $6::date, $7::timestamptz, $8::timestamptz, $9::int, $10::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}}
SET "po_number" = $2::text, "supplier_id" = $3::int, "warehouse_id" = $4::int, "status" = $5::text, "total_value" = $6::numeric, "expected_date" = $7::date, "ordered_at" = $8::timestamptz, "received_at" = $9::timestamptz, "buyer_id" = $10::int, "notes" = $11::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "po_number", "supplier_id", "warehouse_id", "status", "total_value", "expected_date", "ordered_at", "received_at", "buyer_id", "notes", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
SELECT id, "po_number"::text AS label FROM {{table:purchase_orders}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY "po_number" LIMIT 500
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET "status" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "status"
UPDATE {{table:purchase_orders}} SET "buyer_id" = $2::int, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "buyer_id"
